description: o1-preview is OpenAI's reasoning model designed for complex problem-solving. It uses chain-of-thought reasoning internally before producing a response, excelling at science, coding, and math tasks that require multi-step reasoning.

architecture.reasoningTokens: Uses internal chain-of-thought tokens (not visible to user)

trainingData.description: Trained using reinforcement learning to perform chain-of-thought reasoning. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained with reinforcement learning to reason through problems step-by-step before responding. Uses internal chain-of-thought that is hidden from the user.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Ranks in the 89th percentile on competitive programming questions (Codeforces), places among the top 500 students in the USA Math Olympiad qualifier (AIME), and exceeds PhD-level accuracy on a benchmark of physics, biology, and chemistry problems (GPQA).

knownLimitations: Higher latency due to internal reasoning process
No image or audio input support
No function calling or structured outputs

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has implemented safety measures but the model may still exhibit biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Chain-of-thought reasoning includes safety considerations. The model is trained to refuse harmful requests.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out.

access.rateLimits: More restricted than GPT-4o due to compute requirements
